trail.name: Phelps Lake Loop
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Laurance S. Rockefeller Preserve Trailhead marker, approximately 5.3 m from the reviewed USGS access trail. This is the Preserve loop, not the Death Canyon out-and-back. The trailhead-area forecast cannot describe every elevation or exposure around the lake.

comparison.note: USGS geometry is about 6.441 miles for the complete lake loop from the official NPS Preserve trailhead marker. It excludes the Death Canyon approach and optional Aspen/Boulder Ridge extensions.

photo.alt: A log bench overlooks Phelps Lake and snow-streaked mountains framed by pine trees.
photo.permissionNote: The official activity page credits C. Adams for NPS and displays no third-party restriction. Retain credit and source; no endorsement implied. The same verified south-shore scene serves both Preserve routes without duplicating the large asset.
